mechanisms.decisive_claim: There is a sequence delta_N>0 with delta_N log N tending to infinity such that deleting exactly n<=N^(1-delta_N) hits every bad support.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use balanced nonuniform 2-adic padding to place a support-minimal unequal relation wholly above N^(1-delta_N) along arbitrarily large constructed cutoffs.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A finite union of nested global log-defect threshold deletions of total size o(N) is a transversal of H_N.
mechanisms.kill_test: A finite union of nested lower-tail thresholds equals the lowest threshold; apply the balanced-padding thin-tail family beyond it.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Independent deletion with every probability strictly below one but proportional to the promoted weight produces a transversal with probability one without alteration.
mechanisms.kill_test: For any fixed minimal bad support on which every deletion probability is below one, the event that no support vertex is deleted has strictly positive probability.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Choose a maximal vertex-disjoint family of residual bad supports and delete one arbitrary representative from each; this always hits every residual support.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the arithmetic circuit triangle {2,3,6}, {5,6,30}, {2,5,10}: a maximal disjoint family can contain one edge and an arbitrary representative can miss both other edges.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After smooth-core and short-circuit removal, bad-event dependencies admit a weighted resampling or alteration scheme whose total expected deletion is O(log log N) times the log-defect mass.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute the exact dependency load on overlapping graph-circuit books and reject unless an all-N witness compression bounds every resampling neighborhood.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every residual minimal circuit after smooth-core removal has a canonical largest-prime endpoint owner, and every integer owns circuits at only O(log log N) total charged weight.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct multi-scale reused-prime circuit books and calculate owner congestion; the claim survives only with the lower-prime residue state included.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Fibring each rough integer by its largest active prime makes valuation balance triangular, so fibre cardinality differences vanish one prime at a time without carrying cofactors.
mechanisms.kill_test: The relation 2*3=6 has largest-prime fibre 3 balanced in count but transfers a factor 2 into the lower fibre, invalidating residue-free triangular elimination.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: One active-prime cardinality stratum contains 1-o(1) of the rough squarefree integers and is admissible by summing valuation equations.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use Poisson-binomial anti-concentration on growing finite prime cylinders: when active reciprocal mass tends to infinity and individual probabilities vanish, the largest single count atom is o(1).

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A union of consecutive active-prime degree strata is certified by total active incidence and can approach density one.
mechanisms.kill_test: K_(s+1,s) with its edge primes active gives an unequal relation whose vertices lie exactly in the adjacent degree strata s and s+1.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every prime-exponent instance, the minimum transversal of unbalanced distinct-coefficient circuits is at most a universal constant times exponent-matrix rank.
mechanisms.kill_test: On {2^1,...,2^(6r)}, rank is one but r vertex-disjoint relations 2^(3j+1)*2^(3j+2)=2^(6j+3) force transversal number at least r.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A rule depending on valuations at only a fixed finite prime set can admit the full zero-signature cylinder and remain distinct-factor admissible.
mechanisms.kill_test: Choose all edge and padding primes outside the controlled set; balanced padding embeds a support-minimal bad relation entirely in the zero-signature cylinder.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A largest-prime factor-tree recursion that carries lower-prime residue tokens has a bounded potential and yields either an o(log N) ownership load or a stabilizing zero-density deletion rule.
mechanisms.kill_test: Write exact two- and three-level token recurrences on edge-prime circuits with common padding and refute any potential that grows linearly in depth or circuit support.
